responsibility: Implements common out-of-line target support for VxWorks. It provides constructor/destructor section emission for configurations using numbered .ctors/.dtors, builds the control-object type and initializer used for VxWorks emulated TLS, performs VxWorks-specific option override logic such as selecting native versus emulated TLS, ctor/dtor availability, PIC restrictions, and debugger-friendly DWARF defaults, and overrides builtin __clear_cache expansion to call cacheTextUpdate directly. This file contains the shared VxWorks runtime/codegen helpers that complement the macro/spec policy in vxworks.h.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file in the vxworks same-name group: it contains shared VxWorks helper code for ctor/dtor section emission, emulated TLS object layout/initialization, target option overrides, and __clear_cache expansion, while gcc/config/vxworks.h defines the main VxWorks macros/specs and hook bindings and gcc/config/vxworks.opt only declares the VxWorks options.
